text:
Elena: Quick async pulse for the quarterly goals — please reply with one short line: shipped, slipped (if any), owner, blockers/deps, and any CR pings. Need a short summary for Friday's review.

Marco: Shipped — hosted API continuous batching opt (v1) rolled to prod. Owner: Marco. CR merged this AM. Observed ~9% tokens/sec improvement and ~8% cost reduction on the workload tests. No open blockers.

Priya: Slipped — Dedicated autoscale policy v2 delayed. Owner: Priya. Blocker: autoscaler K8s controller causing pod churn under burst loads. Dependency: eng-infra to stabilize node pool + kernel updates. CR #512 in review, pinging @Jonah for review. ETA TBD.

Jonah: On it — will review CR #512 today. Quick mitigation: plan to roll back to policy v1 for impacted customers if we see continued churn. I can draft rollback steps once review is done.

Aisha: Shipped — Private onboarding tests for initial VPC flow completed (internal). Owner: Aisha. Slipped — on-prem installer hit cert handling bug during TLS handshake on a subset of 1.5. Blocker: compliance sign-off and KMS config validation. No CRs; installer PR pending extra test coverage.

Niko: SRE note — canary for batching rolled to 10% traffic earlier; seeing a p99 tail bump ~+200ms for seq >2k. Investigating whether it's KV-cache pressure. Tagging @Marco @Elena.

Elena: Thanks. Action items: Marco capture perf numbers for the deck; Priya estimate ETA for autoscaler fix (best/worst case); Jonah coordinate rollback plan + timeline; Aisha get sec sign-off ETA and confirm on-prem installer test plan. Also add one-line cost impact where relevant.

Priya: ETA: if CR feedback is small, we can patch in ~3 business days; if it requires controller changes, 7-10 business days. Cost impact: customers on Dedicated may see ~5-10% CPU inefficiency until fix. I'll update PR description with repro logs.

Marco: Perf numbers (quick): p50 unchanged, p95 improved 12%, overall tokens/sec +9% on representative traffic. I pushed a short writeup to the doc: https://redwood.internal/qtr/pulse (internal). Will copy numbers into the Friday summary.

Jonah: Leaving review comments on CR #512 now. If green, I'll merge and bump the autoscaler helm chart, then start a patch canary. I'll also paste a rollback checklist here.

Aisha: Security sign-off waiting on KMS decrypt validation from Nicole. If that finishes EOD Thu we can unblock GA.

Nicole: Acknowledged — will finish validation EOD Thu. Note: KMS key rotation flow needs to be documented before GA; filing a small doc PR.

Elena: Final ask — can each owner drop one short-line summary here by EOD Thu (shipped/slipped + ETA if slipped). If you need a PR/CR reminder, react with :bell: and I'll nudge reviewers.

Marco: :thumbsup: will post the one-line and attach numbers.

Priya: :bell: pls ping eng-infra if I don't update by EOD.

Jonah: :bell: will paste rollback playbook and timeline in the next update.

Niko: deploy-bot: canary rollout completed to 10% at 15:12 UTC — no errors reported in the first 30m.

Elena: Perfect — thanks all. I'll assemble the Friday summary from these one-lines.
